questions.q: How is God's Spirit living in you different from god being in everything?
questions.answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, but God is still distinct from us and holy. Pantheism says god is part of everything, even rocks and trees, with no line at all.

questions.q: Why does it matter that God is distinct from the world He made?
questions.answer: If God were part of everything, worshiping rocks or trees would be no different, which is idolatry. Because he's distinct and holy, we have a real standard for right and wrong.

questions.q: How can you talk about a friend's beliefs honestly and still show love?
questions.answer: For example: listen first and never mock what they believe, then gently share why I don't think it lines up with reality, remembering that changing how you see the world is hard.
